_design_decision_non_delegable_storage_r: BE spec §5 'Test ownership' (:527) assigns M1 the STORAGE half of test #25: the database itself must reject a tenant_capability_grants row whose action_key is not delegable (role.manage, every preset key). The pinned DDL (:119-171) has only a plain FK to tenant_capability_actions, which cannot express that. Owner-ranked option (Tier A, decided here, do not AWAIT): add a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger forbid_non_delegable_capability_grant() on tenant_capability_grants raising ERRCODE check_violation when (SELECT delegable FROM tenant_capability_actions WHERE action_key = NEW.action_key) IS DISTINCT FROM true. A CHECK constraint cannot reference another table; a generated column would duplicate registry state. This is additive to the pinned DDL, not a deviation from it — record it in the migration header and in the README entry.
